page.title: どんな条件でも結論は同じ

analysis.summaryJa: no matter＋疑問詞は「どんな条件でも主節の結論は変わらない」という譲歩を表す。whoever・whatever・whichever・whenever・wherever・howeverにも同様の譲歩用法がある。さらにwhatを含む定型表現として、what we call、what is more、what is worse、what with A and Bを文脈に応じて使い分ける。
grammarPoints: no matter who/what/which/when/where/how＋主語＋動詞で無条件の譲歩を表す
no matter節が先でも後でも主節の結論は維持される
wh-everは多くの場合no matter＋whに言い換えられる
what we callは「いわゆる」、what is more/worseは情報を追加する談話表現
what with A and Bは複数の事情・原因をまとめて示す
visualEvidence: 異なる条件カードがすべて同じ結論の出口へ集まる図がある
NO MATTER＋WHの式とWH-EVERの対応が示される
what we call・what is more・what is worse・what withの四つの定型札が並ぶ
条件が変わっても結果ランプが点灯したままの図がある
commonTraps: no matter節の内部を直接疑問の倒置語順にする
既知の選択肢を伴うwhicheverと無制限のwhateverを混同する
what is moreとwhat withの機能を混同する

questions.prompt: No matter ------- late the flight arrives, the shuttle will be waiting.

choices.C: how

questions.translationJa: 便の到着がどれほど遅くても、送迎車は待機しています。
questions.explanationJa: 形容詞lateの程度を表すためno matter howを使います。

questions.prompt: ------- chooses the venue, the capacity requirement will remain the same.

choices.C: Whichever room

questions.translationJa: 誰が会場を選んでも、収容人数の要件は同じです。
questions.explanationJa: 人が誰であっても結論が変わらないためWhoeverを使います。

questions.prompt: No matter ------- route the driver takes, a toll will apply.

choices.C: that

questions.translationJa: 運転手がどの経路を使っても通行料がかかります。
questions.explanationJa: routeという既知の選択対象を伴うためno matter which routeです。

questions.prompt: The device must be inspected, ------- it was purchased.

choices.C: whatever

questions.translationJa: その装置は購入場所にかかわらず点検が必要です。
questions.explanationJa: 場所がどこであってもという譲歩をwhereverで表します。

questions.prompt: No matter ------- the customer decides, record the decision in the case file.

choices.C: whoever person

questions.translationJa: 顧客が何を決めても、その決定を案件ファイルに記録してください。
questions.explanationJa: 決定内容が何であってもをno matter whatで表します。

questions.prompt: This is ------- we call a provisional estimate.

choices.C: what

questions.translationJa: これはいわゆる暫定見積額です。
questions.explanationJa: what we callは「私たちが〜と呼ぶもの」、転じて「いわゆる」を表します。

questions.prompt: The new printer is faster; ------- is more, it uses less power.

choices.C: that

questions.translationJa: 新しいプリンターは高速で、そのうえ消費電力も少ないです。
questions.explanationJa: 追加の利点を述べる定型表現what is moreを完成させます。

questions.prompt: The shipment is late, and ------- is worse, several items are damaged.

choices.C: how it

questions.translationJa: 荷物は遅れており、さらに悪いことに数点が破損しています。
questions.explanationJa: 悪い情報を追加する定型表現what is worseです。

questions.prompt: ------- with the road closure and the heavy rain, deliveries took twice as long.

choices.C: How

questions.translationJa: 道路閉鎖や大雨のせいで、配送には通常の2倍の時間がかかりました。
questions.explanationJa: what with A and Bは複数の事情を原因としてまとめます。

questions.prompt: ------- the seminar is held, the same safety rules will apply.

choices.C: Whatever

questions.translationJa: セミナーがいつ開催されても、同じ安全規則が適用されます。
questions.explanationJa: 時がいつであっても結論が同じなのでWheneverを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence expressing an unchanged result.

choices.A: No matter who does answer he, ask for the reference number.
choices.B: No matter that answers, ask for the reference number.
choices.C: No matter whom is answer, ask for the reference number.
choices.D: No matter who answers, ask for the reference number.

questions.translationJa: 誰が応答しても、照会番号を尋ねてください。
questions.explanationJa: no matter who節内ではwhoがanswersの主語を兼ねます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about any method.

choices.A: How ever do you submit the form, keep a copy.
choices.B: However you submit the form, keep a copy.
choices.C: No matter that you submit the form, keep a copy.
choices.D: Whatever person submits the form, keep a copy.

questions.translationJa: どの方法で書類を提出しても、控えを保管してください。
questions.explanationJa: however＋主語＋動詞で方法にかかわらない譲歩を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct no-matter sentence with normal clause order.

choices.A: No matter where does the conference take place, remote access will be available.
choices.B: No matter that where the conference takes place, remote access will be available.
choices.C: No matter where the conference takes place, remote access will be available.
choices.D: No matter the conference where takes place, remote access will be available.

questions.translationJa: 会議がどこで開かれても、遠隔参加が可能です。
questions.explanationJa: no matter where節の内部は主語the conference＋動詞takesの通常語順です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence using a fixed what expression.

choices.A: The lease has what we call an automatic renewal clause.
choices.B: The lease has what do we call an automatic renewal clause.
choices.C: The lease has which we call it an automatic renewal clause.
choices.D: The lease has the clause what we call it automatic renewal.

questions.translationJa: その賃貸契約には、いわゆる自動更新条項があります。
questions.explanationJa: what we callが後続名詞句を「いわゆる」と説明します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence adding a favorable point.

choices.A: The location is convenient; what with, parking is free.
choices.B: The location is convenient; what does more, parking is free.
choices.C: The location is convenient; which is more it, parking is free.
choices.D: The location is convenient; what is more, parking is free.

questions.translationJa: その場所は便利で、そのうえ駐車場は無料です。
questions.explanationJa: 好ましい情報を追加する談話表現what is moreが適切です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence adding a more serious problem.

choices.A: The order is incomplete; what is more better, the invoice is incorrect.
choices.B: The order is incomplete; what with, the invoice is incorrect.
choices.C: The order is incomplete; what is worse, the invoice is incorrect.
choices.D: The order is incomplete; what does worse, the invoice is incorrect.

questions.translationJa: 注文品は不足しており、さらに悪いことに請求書も誤っています。
questions.explanationJa: 悪化する情報の追加にはwhat is worseを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence combining two causes.

choices.A: What is more staff shortages and equipment repairs, production slowed.
choices.B: What with staff shortages and equipment repairs, production slowed.
choices.C: No matter staff shortages and equipment repairs, production slowed.
choices.D: What did with staff shortages and equipment repairs, production slowed.

questions.translationJa: 人員不足や設備修理のため、生産が遅れました。
questions.explanationJa: what with A and Bが複数の事情を理由としてまとめます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about any time.

choices.A: Whenever does the supplier respond, forward the message to me.
choices.B: No matter that the supplier responds, forward the message to me.
choices.C: Whatever time does the supplier respond, forward the message to me.
choices.D: Whenever the supplier responds, forward the message to me.

questions.translationJa: 仕入先がいつ返答しても、そのメッセージを私へ転送してください。
questions.explanationJa: Whenever節内はthe supplier respondsの通常語順です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about any choice among listed plans.

choices.A: Whatever of the listed plans do you select, the setup fee is the same.
choices.B: Whichever do you select plan, the setup fee is the same.
choices.C: Whichever plan you select, the setup fee is the same.
choices.D: No matter that plan you select, the setup fee is the same.

questions.translationJa: 記載されたどのプランを選んでも、初期費用は同じです。
questions.explanationJa: 既知のプランからどれを選んでもという譲歩にWhichever planを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with no matter how.

choices.A: No matter how busy the lobby becomes, keep the exit clear.
choices.B: No matter how does the lobby become busy, keep the exit clear.
choices.C: No matter what busy the lobby becomes, keep the exit clear.
choices.D: However the lobby does busy become, keep the exit clear.

questions.translationJa: ロビーがどれほど混雑しても、出口を空けておいてください。
questions.explanationJa: 形容詞busyをhowの直後に置き、節内は通常語順です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “No matter when you arrive, call reception.”

choices.B: Call reception only before you arrive.
choices.C: Reception will decide whether you may arrive.

questions.translationJa: いつ到着しても受付へ電話してください。
questions.explanationJa: no matter whenとwheneverは時にかかわらない同じ譲歩を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Whoever leads the tour must wear a badge.”

choices.A: The tourists choose a badge instead of a leader.
choices.C: Only the current manager may lead the tour.
choices.D: Any person who leads the tour must wear a badge.

questions.translationJa: 見学を案内する人は誰でも名札を着用しなければなりません。
questions.explanationJa: whoeverはany person whoと同じく人を限定しません。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Whatever happens, the office will remain open.”

choices.A: Nothing can ever happen at the office.
choices.B: The office will close if anything happens.
choices.C: The office will remain open regardless of what happens.
choices.D: The office determines what will happen.

questions.translationJa: 何が起きてもオフィスは営業を続けます。
questions.explanationJa: whatever節は出来事にかかわらず主節の結論が変わらないことを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The device is what we call backward compatible.”

choices.A: The device can operate only in reverse.
choices.B: The device has the property commonly described as backward compatibility.
choices.C: No one knows what the device is called.
choices.D: The device is incompatible with every earlier version.

questions.translationJa: その装置はいわゆる下位互換です。
questions.explanationJa: what we callは一般にそう呼ばれる名称・性質を導きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The service is cheaper; what is more, it is faster.”

choices.A: The service costs less and also operates faster.
choices.B: The service is cheaper because it is slower.
choices.C: Speed is the only disadvantage of the service.
choices.D: The price and speed are both unknown.

questions.translationJa: そのサービスは安く、そのうえ速いです。
questions.explanationJa: what is moreは同方向の追加情報を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The package was late; what is worse, it was wet.”

choices.A: The package was late but otherwise perfect.
choices.C: In addition to arriving late, the package had the more serious problem of being wet.
choices.D: The package was late because no rain fell.

questions.translationJa: 荷物は遅れ、さらに悪いことに濡れていました。
questions.explanationJa: what is worseは先の問題より悪い問題を追加します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “What with traffic and snow, the driver was delayed.”

choices.A: The driver avoided both traffic and snow.
choices.B: The delay caused traffic and snow.
choices.C: Weather had no connection to the trip.
choices.D: Traffic and snow contributed to the driver’s delay.

questions.translationJa: 交通渋滞や雪のため運転手は遅れました。
questions.explanationJa: what with A and BはAやBといった事情が原因であることを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Wherever the booth is placed, it needs electricity.”

choices.A: The booth needs electricity regardless of its location.
choices.B: Electricity determines who owns the booth.
choices.C: The booth needs no power outdoors.
choices.D: Place the booth only near the entrance.

questions.translationJa: ブースをどこに設置しても電源が必要です。
questions.explanationJa: whereverは場所にかかわらず同じ要件が成り立つことを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “No matter which carrier we use, insurance is required.”

choices.A: Only one named carrier offers insurance.
choices.B: Insurance is necessary with every available carrier.
choices.C: We must choose insurance instead of a carrier.
choices.D: Using a carrier eliminates the need for insurance.

questions.translationJa: どの運送業者を使っても保険が必要です。
questions.explanationJa: no matter whichは既知の候補のどれでも結論が同じことを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “However carefully we pack it, some risk remains.”

choices.A: We should not pack the item carefully.
choices.B: Careful packing removes every possible risk.
choices.C: Some risk remains no matter how carefully we pack the item.
choices.D: The item itself decides how to pack us.

questions.translationJa: どれほど慎重に梱包しても、ある程度の危険は残ります。
questions.explanationJa: however＋副詞はno matter how＋副詞に対応します。

questions.prompt: The hotel desk is staffed all night. No matter ------- your train arrives, someone can check you in.

choices.C: who

questions.translationJa: ホテルのフロントは終夜有人です。列車がいつ着いてもチェックインできます。
questions.explanationJa: 時にかかわらないことをno matter when＋通常語順で表します。

questions.prompt: Several employees may receive the courier. ------- signs for the parcel must write the time on the receipt.

choices.C: Who does

questions.translationJa: 複数の従業員が荷物を受け取る可能性があります。署名する人は誰でも受領時刻を記入してください。
questions.explanationJa: 人が誰であっても同じ義務があるためWhoeverを使います。

questions.prompt: The three service plans use the same support team. ------- plan you select, support is available 24 hours a day.

choices.C: What did

questions.translationJa: 3つのサービスプランは同じサポート班を利用します。どのプランでも24時間対応です。
questions.explanationJa: 既知の3プランのどれでもという譲歩をWhichever planで表します。

questions.prompt: The field team works throughout the region. ------- the equipment is installed, the same inspection checklist applies.

choices.C: Wherever

questions.translationJa: 現地班は地域全域で作業します。設備をどこに設置しても同じ点検表を使います。
questions.explanationJa: 場所が変わっても結論が同じなのでWhereverです。

questions.prompt: The road may reopen at noon or remain closed all day. No matter ------- happens, notify every driver.

choices.C: that what

questions.translationJa: 道路は正午に再開するか終日閉鎖の可能性があります。何が起きても全運転手へ知らせてください。
questions.explanationJa: 出来事の内容を限定しないno matter whatを使います。

questions.prompt: The consultant identified a temporary workaround. It is ------- we call a stopgap measure.

choices.C: what do

questions.translationJa: コンサルタントは一時的な回避策を示しました。これはいわゆる応急措置です。
questions.explanationJa: 名称を説明する定型表現what we callが適切です。

questions.prompt: The new warehouse is closer to customers. ------- is more, its rent is lower.

choices.C: That what

questions.translationJa: 新倉庫は顧客に近く、そのうえ賃料も安いです。
questions.explanationJa: 追加の利点を示すWhat is moreを使います。

questions.prompt: The replacement part will arrive late. ------- is worse, the current machine cannot operate without it.

choices.C: That it

questions.translationJa: 交換部品は遅れて届き、さらに悪いことに現行機はその部品なしでは動きません。
questions.explanationJa: より深刻な悪影響を加えるWhat is worseが適切です。

questions.prompt: The outdoor event started late. ------- with strong wind and a power failure, setup took three extra hours.

choices.C: What

questions.translationJa: 屋外行事は開始が遅れました。強風や停電のため設営に3時間余計にかかりました。
questions.explanationJa: 二つの原因をまとめるWhat with A and Bを使います。

questions.prompt: The client may revise the order repeatedly. ------- often the quantities change, update the inventory file immediately.

choices.C: Whoever

questions.translationJa: 顧客は何度も注文を修正するかもしれません。数量がどれほど頻繁に変わっても在庫ファイルを直ちに更新してください。
questions.explanationJa: 頻度を表す副詞oftenをhoweverの直後に置き、無条件の譲歩を作ります。
